entities.name: DEW
entities.description: The black-ops arm of ECAP that conducted forbidden human experimentation to create controllable meta-soldiers.
entities.quote: D.E.W. — “Division of Experimental Warfare” Nature The black-ops arm of ECAP, initially hidden under research budget names. Not just studying metas — making them.

updates.new_facts: Originally a government-founded scientific and military institute created to regulate and research superhuman phenomena, serving as a front for DEW's darker operations.
updates.quote: E.C.A.P. — “Enhanced Cognition & Applied Phenomena” Nature A government-founded scientific and military institute, created originally to regulate and research superhuman phenomena after the first Sentinel emergence.

updates.new_facts: Formed from surviving DEW scientists, military officers, and World Order backers, operating as a shadow syndicate with the goal of erasing individuality.
updates.quote: The Covenant Nature A shadow syndicate formed from surviving DEW scientists, military officers, and World Order backers. They believe metas are divine mistakes that need to be re-forged under one consciousness.

timeline_events.title: The Storm Rebellion
timeline_events.description: Atrocities of DEW were exposed during this event, leading to internal collapse when Samuel turned on them.
timeline_events.quote: Exposure of their atrocities during “The Storm Rebellion.” Internal collapse when Samuel (Ghost-01) turned on them, leaking files to the public.
